operads/infrastructure/legacy/catalog_v2: Full body reviewed. Immutable catalog wrappers bind raw byte spans and canonical payload digests, enforce selected IDs/duplicates and strict declarations for BOUND lifecycles. Constructors do not authenticate lifecycle TESTED/COMPOSABLE/ADMITTED receipts, resolve meta-skill references, validate node assignments against actual nodes/licenses, or check substitution slot/equality witnesses; these remain trusted declaration fields. _sha256 uses int(...,16) rather than exact hex grammar, allowing a leading sign in the 64-character suffix.
